info.name: Tyk Dashboard Admin Additional Permissions API

items.docs: This API returns by default the initial set of additional permissions defined in your Tyk Dashboard configuration, under `security.additional_permissions`. Once you update the permissions via the API, they will be stored at organisation level.

Whenever you want to add/update/delete an additional permission, just send back the updated list of permissions, through this PUT request to the API.
